about.label: 01 // whoami
about.p1: I am a Systems Analysis and Development (ADS) student at the Federal Institute of Pernambuco (IFPE) and a certified IT Maintenance and Support Technician. I currently intern at Sesc Pernambuco's Digital Technology Unit (UTD), handling internal platform configuration, technical documentation, functional QA testing, and WordPress hotsite maintenance.
about.p2: Previously, I spent over 4 years as a technical support scholarship assistant at UFPE's IT Superintendence (STI/NATI-CB), resolving tickets through SIPAC, administering Windows and Linux workstations, and supporting LAN infrastructure. That operational foundation drove my transition into software engineering focused on Java, Python, SQL, Git/GitHub, Docker, process automation, and AI development workflows.
